description: Creates a reusable set of inbound and outbound rules. Without rules it starts with SSH (TCP 22) and ping open from anywhere; pass rules: [] for none. Nothing is filtered until it is attached to a machine. Scope: network.write.

destinations.description: Outbound rules only: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges allowed out to. Omitted or empty: anywhere.

direction.description: in (default) lets traffic in; out lets it out. The first outbound rule makes outbound restrictive.

ports.description: TCP/UDP only: "22", "80,443" or a range "8000-8100" (up to 15 items). Omitted or null: all ports.

protocol.description: icmp covers ping for IPv4 and IPv6; any is every protocol.

sources.description: Inbound rules only: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or ranges allowed in. Omitted or empty: anywhere.

name: create_firewall
title: Create a firewall
